entry.name: logand
entry.description: Compares one number to another and outputs a if the two numbers are both non-zero or a if either number is 0.

arguments.name: comparison-value

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Perform the comparison with the most recent values
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the operation with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holds.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Compare to the stored value, cause output

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is compared to the number in the left inlet to determine output but only a number in the left inlet will trigger output.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Compare to the stored value, cause output
messages.description: If the number in both inlets is not, then the output is. If the number in one or both of the inlets is, then the output is. A number in the left inlet triggers the output.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the incoming value without output
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number will set the input value without causing output.

inlets.digest: Set Left Operand, Trigger the Calculation
